messages:
alex: Quick sync — propose we run a shadow-sampling canary for v2 ranking before any user-visible rollout. Goal: validate quality + perf in prod without affecting outputs. Draft plan below — please react.

maria: 👍 can you outline sampling, metrics, rollback thresholds?

jordan: Sketch: 1% shadow (no user-visible change) -> compare rankings/embeddings + latency. If clean, move to 5% live A/B vs v1 for quality signals.

sam: For infra: need feature-flag gating + autoscale buffer. Also want immediate regional kill-switch (manual & automated).

alex: Rough schedule:
- Phase 0: shadow 1% (us-east only) 48h
- Phase 1: live A/B 5% (us-east + eu-west) 72h
- Phase 2: ramp to 20% over 7d, then 100% if stable

anya: Heads-up — a couple enterprise customers requested an opt-in canary so they can test before full roll. We should support tenant-level opt-in.

jordan: Rollback guardrails (proposed):
- auto-rollback if error-rate > 0.5% absolute OR 5x baseline for 10m
- p95 latency increase > 30% sustained 15m -> trigger fallback
- quality regression: drop in eval pass rate > 1.5% on the core prompt set -> pause rollout

maria: Fallback tiers to implement (priority):
1) immediate route to golden variant
2) fallback to quantized v1 (lower quality, faster)
3) degrade to queue + return polite delayed response message when load spike

sam: Example config for the feature flag I had in mind:
```json
{
  "flag": "v2_shadow",
  "phases": [{"pct":1,"mode":"shadow","regions":["us-east"]},
             {"pct":5,"mode":"ab","regions":["us-east","eu-west"]}],
  "auto_rollback": {"error_rate":0.005,"p95_delta":0.3}
}
```

alex: Two questions: how long do we need to run shadow to get meaningful quality signals, and who signs off to promote?

jordan: Need at least 48h in shadow with sample size > 10k requests for statistical power on the core prompts. Promotion requires product + eng + cs signoff (alex, jordan, anya). Ops can trigger automated rollback without signoff.

maria: Monitoring checklist: add dashboards for "shadow-delta" (score distribution), "per-tenant drift", and "latency-by-region". Alerts -> #eng-oncall + paging if rollback conditions hit.

anya: Also log candidate diffs for enterprise opt-ins so they can audit outputs locally. We'll draft a short privacy note for them.

sam: Operational notes: reserve +1 node per pool during ramp, add a preflight to validate KV cache warmup so first requests are fast.

alex: Launch criteria (one-liners):
- Shadow delta <= 0.8% on core eval set
- p95 latency increase <= 10% (vs baseline)
- No production incidents for 72h post-ramp
- Enterprise opt-ins report no negative regressions

jordan: I'm adding a canary flag PR now, will include integration tests and mock telemetry. @maria can you add the rollback runbook?

maria: On it. I'll post the runbook link and pager playbook once ready.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated: v2_shadow -> us-east (shadow 1%) at 1923456890

alex: Thanks all — I'll consolidate into a single doc and send to execs tomorrow. Action items: jordan PR, maria runbook, sam infra reservation, anya opt-in email draft.
